claims.claim: Cai develops a five-year T2D prediction nomogram using LASSO selection followed by multivariable Cox modeling, with six final predictors.

location.section: Abstract; Results / Establishment of a Predicting Nomogram

claims.claim: Cai's analyzed cohort includes 12940 participants and 201 incident events, including 47 events in internal validation.

location.section: Results / Characteristics of the Derivation and Validation Cohorts

claims.claim: Cai identifies Dryad 10.5061/dryad.8q0p192 as the data source and describes baseline predictors, incident T2D and follow-up duration in the original file.
Liu develops Cox prediction comparisons in RICH and applies frozen coefficients, standardization parameters and baseline risk to NAGALA for three-year external validation.
Liu reports IPCW AUC/Brier, calibration and bootstrap/leave-one-center-out validation, and cites two public Dryad datasets.
Liu treats decision curves as exploratory rather than establishing clinical utility because no intervention-linked threshold was prespecified and transported probabilities were not recalibrated.
The 2020 Chinese three-year nomogram compares full, stepwise, MFP and LASSO logistic models, rather than providing the preferred survival exercise.
